rationale: First-order heater with large lag. E8 is a measured equilibrium: u=0.45 holds y=0.502 flat for 120 s with zero slope, so feedforward ff=0.45 for target 0.5. E1+E3 give tau~158 s (E3 decay 0.486->0.19 in 179 s => tau=158 s; E1 rise 0.05->0.389 in 179 s with yss=0.55 matches same tau), gain K~1.0 above ambient 0.05 (0.05+0.45*1.0=0.50), delay only 6-12 s, quantization ~0.0054, noise <0.01 vs band 0.05, no deadzone above 0.4. Structure: ff=(target-0.05)/1.0 + PI on filtered y. Kp=1.8, Ki=0.025 gives closed loop 158s^2+(1+Kp)s+Ki=0 with wn=0.0126, zeta=0.70, ~5% overshoot, real part 0.0089 for ~450 s small-signal settling but saturated warmup at ~0.8 reaches 0.5 in ~145 s. Filter tau_f=10 s smooths quantization with negligible lag vs 158 s. Integral stored as I-term limited to +-0.20 leaves authority to correct ff error >0.10 while preventing windup; conditional freeze when saturated and error drives deeper into saturation prevents warmup windup. Output clamped to [0,1] with adaptive hi=ff+0.35 (0.80 for target 0.5, equilibrium 0.85/0.80 safe below soft 0.85/hard 0.9) plus emergency u=0 if yf>=0.82.

extra.machine_card: Electric heater, positive gain, self-draining to room. Gain ~1.0 above ambient 0.05: y_ss ~0.05+1.0*u. Measured: u=0.45 holds y=0.502 flat 120 s (E8); u=0.5 rising to 0.486 still rising (E1-E2, eq~0.55); u=0.41 near eq~0.46; u=0.44 near 0.49; u=0.47 rising through 0.502 toward ~0.52. Lag: pure delay 6-12 s, dominant first-order tau ~155-160 s, settling >500 s. Max rate ~0.006/s per unit u. Cooling with u=0: 0.486->0.19 in 180 s, still falling. No deadzone above 0.4. Noise: quantization ~0.0054 steps, peak-peak <0.01, band is 0.475-0.525 width 0.05. Limits: soft 0.85, hard cutoff 0.9 forces u=0. Target 0.5 needs steady duty ~0.45.
extra.predicted_behavior: From cold 0.05 at full ~0.80, reaches 0.4 in ~100 s, band entry ~140-160 s, inside band by ~180-220 s. Small-signal overshoot <0.01 above target (<0.51) due to zeta 0.7 and 10 s filter delay. Steady: y=0.50+-0.008, u=0.45+-0.03 (I trims residual). After 300 s settling: MAE <0.008, time in band >95%, energy ~u^2=0.20/s. No limit violations, no chatter >0.02.
